scenes.say: Have you ever passed props through several components just to reach a deeply nested child? Is there a better way in React?

scenes.label: Drilling
scenes.sub: Props drilling means passing props through many layers.
scenes.say: Props drilling means passing props through many layers, which can get messy and hard to maintain.
Props are manual and best for local data. Context lets you access global data anywhere, no drilling needed.
Here’s how you set up a context provider. Any component inside can access the theme directly.

scenes.question: Should you use context for all data?
scenes.right: No, use context for global data like theme or auth.
scenes.say: Don’t use context for every piece of data. It’s best for global info like theme or authentication.
